author: lupulupunen

title: A great app for children, teens and adults!
body:
This app has helped me so much!

I have personally tried many schedule/routine apps which have always been dull and have felt a bit ‘copy pasted’. I would eventually get unmotivated and just delete the app. Luckily that was until I found Routinery!

Routinery is a great app because, it organizes my mornings, school routines and even my night routine. 

Routinery is very unique in many ways, like it’s special level up system which you’ll have to see for yourself. It really does motivate you to complete your small routines more often. 

I also love the fun, motivating quotes that are written at the front page of the app. They make me feel more confident and happier each time I click on the app! 

I will definitely be using this app when school starts again.

-L
